diagnostic.purpose: Explain why the 150 ms press passed under the deferred grant. Separate instrumented script outside the test runner; it changed no case result above and no project file.
diagnostic.reading: In all three attempts the 50 ms timer grant was delivered after mouseup, with animation frames about 200 ms apart under the headless software renderer. On this host the timer-deferred adapter therefore does not reproduce the defect even for a 150 ms press. This is a property of this host and adapter, not a measurement of a real browser or of real players.
